armados_arco.prompt_gemini: ARCH ASSEMBLY — a horseshoe arch with straight legs, about 2.5 m wide and 2.2 m tall, built as a band 3 balloons wide of round 12-inch latex balloons packed tightly in staggered rows, with diagonal stripes of lilac and white wrapping around the arch, each stripe made of the balloons' own colors. Keep that pattern readable on the band and make the whole arch only of round latex balloons: no ribbons, streamers or fabric.
